targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, close FROM bars WHERE symbol = 'VCB' ORDER BY ts
SELECT date AS time, realized, unrealized, fees FROM pnl_daily ORDER BY date
SELECT symbol, qty, avg_price, updated_at FROM positions WHERE qty > 0
SELECT service, last_seen, extract(epoch from (now() - last_seen)) AS age_seconds FROM heartbeat
SELECT ts AS time, account_no AS metric, account_balance AS value FROM account_balance_snapshot ORDER BY ts

SELECT account_no, symbol, quantity, cost_price, sellable_quantity, ts FROM account_position_snapshot aps WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM account_position_snapshot WHERE account_no = aps.account_no) ORDER BY account_no, symbol

SELECT b.account_no, b.ts, b.account_balance, b.floating_pl, b.total_pl, m.rc_call, m.account_ratio_ssi, m.account_ratio_vsdc FROM derivative_balance_snapshot b JOIN derivative_margin_snapshot m ON m.account_no = b.account_no AND m.ts = b.ts WHERE b.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM derivative_balance_snapshot WHERE account_no = b.account_no)
